hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund for order 220 (9480 cents) failed with a disk I/O error after 3 attempts and is absent from the refunds ledger, which contains only orders 222 and 223. Any payout computed from net_balance for the customer on order 220 would be overstated by 9480 cents. Refunds must be completed and the ledger corrected before payouts are recorded.
